tools.description: Detect It Easy - advanced PE/ELF packer and compiler detection tool
tools.usage:
die file.exe # Detect packer/compiler
die -d folder/ # Deep scan directory
die -j file.dll # JSON output
die --scan=all binary # Full signature scan

tools.description: Detect It Easy console version for automated malware analysis
tools.usage:
diec sample.exe # Console detection
diec -j malware.bin # JSON output for automation
diec --db # Show signature database info
diec --scan=entropy file.dll # Entropy analysis

tools.description: Detect It Easy lite version optimized for speed and basic detection
tools.usage: diel binary.exe # Fast basic detection\ndiel *.dll # Batch process multiple files\ndiel --verbose sample.bin # Detailed output
